newsitem.title: UK: NatWest Markets names equities head.
newsitem.headline: NatWest Markets names equities head.

text.p: British investment bank NatWest Markets on Friday said it had appointed Joe Lafferty, currently Managing Director of Pan-European Equities, as Global Head of Institutional Equities.
NatWest Markets, part of National Westminster Bank, said Lafferty would be based in New York and be responsible for the firms sales, sales trading and customer trading around the world.
Edmond Warner, Global Head of Research, will additionally be Managing Director of European Equities.

David Atkinson, Deputy Head of Global Research, will take on the role of implementing the firm's global research strategy while Paul Rix, a senior stock and sector strategist, will take over Atkinson's role as Head of Pan-European Research.
NatWest Markets is currently searching for a chief executive to take the job vacated by Martin Owen and currently filled on a temporary basis by NatWest group chief executive Derek Wanless.
Owen left the firm in the wake of a 90 million stg loss in interest rate options trading which also led to the resignation of five other senior staff.

Wanless is spearheading a review of NatWest Markets strategy with a view to improving controls and speeding up the production of acceptable returns in key business areas which have been disappointing.
